parsed.summary: The PR adds support for C++ user-defined literals, but the regex used may not cover all valid UDLs.

issues.description: The regex `user_defined_literal_re` may not cover all valid user-defined literals, such as those with suffixes like `1.0q` or `1.0_q`. This could lead to functional incompleteness.
